name: VirtualDriveChannels
description: TauSync meeting-word identifiers for the virtual drive protocol. PC initiates all channels; Android responds. Both sides call tau.connect() with the exact same string.

members.name: VIRTUAL_DRIVE_LIST
members.description: PC requests a directory listing at a given path. Fixed meeting word.

members.name: VIRTUAL_DRIVE_STAT
members.description: PC requests file or folder metadata (size, mtime, is_dir). Fixed meeting word.

members.name: VIRTUAL_DRIVE_READ
members.description: Base prefix for read sessions. Negotiation channel: PC sends {path, offset, length, uuid}; actual data flows on virtual_drive_read_{uuid}.

members.name: VIRTUAL_DRIVE_WRITE
members.description: Base prefix for write sessions. Negotiation channel: PC sends {path, uuid}; actual data streams on virtual_drive_write_{uuid}.

members.name: VIRTUAL_DRIVE_CREATE
members.description: PC requests creation of a file or directory. Fixed meeting word.

members.name: VIRTUAL_DRIVE_DELETE
members.description: PC requests deletion of a file or directory. Fixed meeting word.

members.name: VIRTUAL_DRIVE_RENAME
members.description: PC requests rename or move of a file or directory. Fixed meeting word.

members.name: VIRTUAL_DRIVE_TRUNCATE
members.description: PC requests a file size change (truncate or extend). Fixed meeting word.
